login.title: Welcome back
login.subtitle: Sign in to pick up where you left off.

register.title: Create your account
register.subtitle: One place for your habits, goals and plans.

sessionEnded: You have been signed out. Sign in again to continue.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.subtitle: Enter the email address of your account and we will send you a reset link.
forgot.sentDescription: If an account exists for {{email}}, a link to reset the password is on its way. The link is valid for 30 minutes.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.subtitle: After the change you will be signed out on all devices.
reset.success: Your password has been changed. Sign in with the new one.
reset.invalidDescription: Open the link from the email again, or request a new one.

verify.successDescription: Thank you. Your account is now fully set up.
verify.errorTitle: This link could not be used
verify.errorDescription: The link is invalid, already used or expired. You can request a new one from the application.

verification.bannerDescription: We sent a confirmation link to {{email}}. Confirming it lets you recover your account if you forget your password.
verification.resent: A new confirmation link was sent to {{email}}.
